tools.name: arvx_get_access
tools.description: How to get access to ARVX: the signup link to give the person, what they must do themselves, the price, and how to add their key to this connector. Call this when there is no key, or when the person asks how to start. Costs nothing.

tools.name: arvx_run_reading
tools.description: Run a Reading on two people from the emails between them. Send at least 3 emails written by the user and 3 by the other person, oldest first. From the second Reading on a pair, send the record from the last Reading exactly as it was returned. Costs one Reading (the first 3 are free). Save the record

tools.name: arvx_record_summary
tools.description: When someone asks what is held about them: returns every item in a saved record in plain words. Needs the record and both people's emails. Never uses up a Reading; 10 a month per account.
